claims: As of March 18, 2026, most major districts in the Washington D.C. area (e.g., Arlington Public Schools, Montgomery County Public Schools) are currently operating under normal status.
As of March 18, 2026, Prince William County Public Schools are under Code Orange (remote learning).
As of March 18, 2026, Arlington Public Schools (APS) are open.
As of March 18, 2026, Montgomery County Public Schools (MCPS) are open (Code Green).
As of March 18, 2026, Prince William County Public Schools (PWCS) schools are closed.
As of March 18, 2026, Prince William County Public Schools (PWCS) are a virtual instruction day.
ABC7 New York and WTVR Richmond report no widespread closures.
